text:
Nia: spotted strange spikes: cost dashboard attributes a lot of requests to the org default project. projectless keys are being routed but billed to default.
Omar: router fallback attaches org.default_project when neither token nor header gives a project. that was intentional for quota.
Tess: we never emitted provenance so billing can't tell if it was asserted by auth or computed by router. propose adding `project_provenance` tag: asserted|claim|fallback.
Bea: security: if we accept asserted values they must be verifiable. prefer signed header from auth-service, not relying on trust between upstream proxies.
Nia: minimal plan: auth-service adds `x-project-assertion` JWT when exchange preserves project; gateway verifies and emits provenance metric but still uses router's effective value for enforcement.
Omar: router pseudocode:
```
if (verify('x-project-assertion')) {
  provenance='asserted'; project=jwt.project
} else if (token.claims.project) {
  provenance='claim'; project=token.claims.project
} else {
  provenance='fallback'; project=org.default_project
}
emitMetric('req.project.attrib', project, provenance)
```
Bea: checklist from audit-bot: JWT signed by auth-service key, TTL <=5s, jti for replay, gateway verifies `iss` and signature, log to audit stream.
audit-bot: audit rule added: require assertion verification in PRs modifying gateway auth.
Tess: UI: add "Attrib" column with dots (green/asserted, amber/claim, grey/fallback) and a filter to exclude fallbacks by default. tooltip explains implications.
Nia: rollout: feature flag `proj_attrib_v1`; staging smoke -> 5% canary -> monitor attribution deltas and billing alignment -> expand. coordinate with finance for any rebilling backfill.
deploy-bot: proj_attrib_v1 enabled in staging :white_check_mark: smoke run queued.
Omar: follow ups: caching verified assertion jti for a few seconds to avoid RSA on every req; consider HMAC or mTLS for perf.
Bea: security sign-off pending spec doc in the RFC.
Nia: I'll draft RFC and assign owners. thanks.
